# Login to simple_note
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
pass_map = {p['account_name']: p['password'] for p in passwords}
simple_note_password = pass_map['simple_note']
username = 'siwhit@gmail.com'
res = apis.simple_note.login(username=username, password=simple_note_password)
print(res)
simple_note_token = res.get('access_token')
print('token_set', bool(simple_note_token))

# Find the Bucket List note(s)
access_token = simple_note_token

page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_notes = []
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query='Bucket List', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # Expect page to be a list
    if not page:
        break
    all_notes.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_matches', len(all_notes))
print(all_notes)
